question: Through what level of speech do scriptural meanings proceed to the transmitters of the tantras?
premises: Scriptural meanings proceed by resorting to the various transmitters of the tantras.
This transmission occurs first at the level of Maya-born Vaikhari.
Vaikhari is described as a cavity or channel through which the meaning comes down.
inference: The descent of scriptural meaning to the transmitters of the tantras first passes through the Maya-born level of Vaikhari speech.
plain_english: Having resorted to those various transmitters of the tantras, they proceed; therefore, at first, as long as they come through the Maya-born cavity of Vaikhari.
